title: Store a function in a name
objective: Write a short function as a value with a function taking, store it with make, and call it like any other function.

body.text: A function does not have to be declared with a function line. Write a function taking followed by its parameter names, then the body on the lines below, and store it with make. The name can then be called as if it were a normal function.

body.title: A function as a value
body.code:
make double equal to a function taking n
    gives back n times 2

say double 5

make greet equal to a function taking name
    gives back "Hello, {name}!"

say greet "Ada"

body.text: A function value can take more than one parameter, and it can be used in a comparison. The result is an ordinary value, so it can be printed or stored.

body.title: Square and check
body.code:
make square equal to a function taking n
    gives back n times n

say square 5

make old enough equal to a function taking age
    gives back age is at least 18

say old enough 7

body.prompt: square should return n times n, but it adds n instead. Change it so square 5 prints 25.
body.starter:
make square equal to a function taking n
    gives back n plus n

say square 5
body.solution:
make square equal to a function taking n
    gives back n times n

say square 5
